WICKFIELD AND HEEP", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u041-b0158", "target": "— Да благословит вас небо! — сказала она, протягивая мне руку.", "source_sha256": "9e0b397e44583baf53a33a3d5eefc50068c3e2cf334aa812f9213668dd73ea62", "target_id": "ru-en85-u041-b0158", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "81149582174e5bb6a91d03c5c84fac5b9bf81c04fb26dcda1056e24447fa38be"}, {"source_id": "en85-u041-b0159", "target": "— Дорогая Агнес! — ответил я. — Я вижу, вы просите меня не говорить о сегодняшнем вечере, но неужели ничего нельзя сделать?", "source_sha256": "dc054ee1645645592475a2ac60082287c02b3f3e83ec35ad6c0eeb705f7df0c9", "target_id": "ru-en85-u041-b0159", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d44c6e7fa55a777533f129dfd1a06537a2901ba8b5fec5b2688c32470bc5555e"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 39, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u041-b0160", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There is God to trust in!’ she replied.", "sha256": "bb13e55addcf8907c183784bc0d9b190836a0e3b243734a6b155cd6ef8706e1b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[160]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0161", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Can I do nothing—I, who come to you with my poor sorrows?’", "sha256": "de50a9e63aef220f7bb48bd9dcc7c913fb964bf231d6eeace6ebcc56bb68318c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[161]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0162", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And make mine so much lighter,’ she replied. ‘Dear Trotwood, no!’", "sha256": "bc96adf86dac68b15391a247a1d529c43a89ab6f3e0fb9a25301d593646c073b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[162]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0163", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dear Agnes,’ I said, ‘it is presumptuous for me, who am so poor in all in which you are so rich—goodness, resolution, all noble qualities—to doubt or direct you; but you know how much I love you, and how much I owe you. You will never sacrifice yourself to a mistaken sense of duty, Agnes?’", "sha256": "55cfa439584142c81af669381b854dfe807fcd9f07c3e50bf20c1be5729e021a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[163]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0164", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "More agitated for a moment than I had ever seen her, she took her hands from me, and moved a step back.", "sha256": "a65a71bbe80de5a186582b7622c785ff2c8867b41be119434075c8f11f843525", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[164]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0165", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Say you have no such thought, dear Agnes! Much more than sister! Think of the priceless gift of such a heart as yours, of such a love as yours!’", "sha256": "7c27f3889d398bf37ab3ba59ba7cb4308c8474c0114e09b6fb52854713f2de3b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[165]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0166", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Oh! long, long afterwards, I saw that face rise up before me, with its momentary look, not wondering, not accusing, not regretting. Oh, long, long afterwards, I saw that look subside, as it did now, into the lovely smile, with which she told me she had no fear for herself—I need have none for her—and parted from me by the name of Brother, and was gone!", "sha256": "cccba6260b72e9c4c2c70b60380cd7bcf211dbde647e467808befa7db0efca67", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[166]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0167", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was dark in the morning, when I got upon the coach at the inn door. The day was just breaking when we were about to start, and then, as I sat thinking of her, came struggling up the coach side, through the mingled day and night, Uriah’s head.", "sha256": "8bd350b2363e8d7a72b6b50cff0d177fad075868b6fb54edb22bd5fe0832b1c4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[167]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0168", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Copperfield!’ said he, in a croaking whisper, as he hung by the iron on the roof, ‘I thought you’d be glad to hear before you went off, that there are no squares broke between us. I’ve been into his room already, and we’ve made it all smooth. Why, though I’m umble, I’m useful to him, you know; and he understands his interest when he isn’t in liquor! What an agreeable man he is, after all, Master Copperfield!’", "sha256": "db9a1abdc848468cdd403e5ddaaa8606f6cb8921504bbd377bf58dc5f370b423", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[168]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0169", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I obliged myself to say that I was glad he had made his apology.", "sha256": "258b96a62b28bfe9c3a29cec06c22ed2c9b882cfbeab673c61eb1c521a86dc3d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[169]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0170", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, to be sure!’ said Uriah. ‘When a person’s umble, you know, what’s an apology? So easy! I say! I suppose,’ with a jerk, ‘you have sometimes plucked a pear before it was ripe, Master Copperfield?’", "sha256": "3ea001cfc77c1dcd243a150bec1fa8fa750c03ceffb874887b96f6af9a62d89a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[170]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0171", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I suppose I have,’ I replied.", "sha256": "a27fed042c49346268620314e8e60b80991c1cc64cc73bc43b347ffa0323de89", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[171]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0172", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I did that last night,’ said Uriah; ‘but it’ll ripen yet! It only wants attending to. I can wait!’", "sha256": "be2ab3c353644d75e105d2b475c213c78e9c85373a3542645c484c88a8999fcb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[172]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u041-b0173", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Profuse in his farewells, he got down again as the coachman got up. For anything I know, he was eating something to keep the raw morning air out; but he made motions with his mouth as if the pear were ripe already, and he were smacking his lips over it.", "sha256": "d2cd49cdc6acbee7d4e2184ff5d081a7aaf2ddc06b54420411a63097e87ce09f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[46]/p[173]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
